mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, user_id, request_id, generation_id, question, answer, status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sv_qa_record (conversation_id, user_id, request_id, generation_id, question, answer, status) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{generationId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sv_qa_record SET answer = CONCAT(answer, #{delta}) WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} AND status = 'STARTED'
